notes: Planning targets of this repository, read by Devostasis when planning.source = file. Ids mirror the phase items in ROADMAP.md and are never reused. A pull request that advances a target carries a line 'Target: <id>' in its description; that marker is the only linkage the engine accepts. A target gets a 'due' date only when the date is real: an invented deadline would improve Horizon without improving the project.

targets.title: Devostasis declares its own plan and debt
Executable conformance vectors for every case the specification names
History keyed by immutable project id instead of owner and name
Conditional requests, backoff and a request budget per run
Band ordering contract that unlocks IMPROVED and WORSENED
Machine-readable fleet index beside the Markdown overview
Release 0.2: phases A and B closed, one outside consumer, no unadopted research unit
Evidence to Action: verified deterministic consumer work scopes, five queues, findings and bounded handoff
Reproducible consumer handoff: accepted receipt identity/compatibility, mutable sources and pinned bounded packets
Consumer Operations: bound repeated observation, operational receipts/results and verified private history transfer
Release 0.3: phases A and B closed, one outside consumer, no unadopted research unit (the bar deferred from the 0.2.0 adoption release)
Offline Repository Analysis: pinned source proof, Python evidence, conservative revision deltas and analyze_code handoff
Release 1.0: compatibility policy per contract, a second provider, a calibration corpus large enough to argue a threshold
